acceptanceCriteria: The workflow triggers once per PR head, has a concurrency group and uses the pinned runner and environment guards.
Either the job is folded into go-product or its distinct purpose is stated in the workflow.
body: Observed 2026-10-04 during a CI audit (Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Tasks build 202) at origin/main e5d47da8; hosted run https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/37198363933 (4 shards, 295 packages, 5635s summed package time, race steps 1924/1647/1397/1264s). Confirmed by reading .github/workflows/intake-containment.yml at e5d47da8: it triggers on both push (all branches) and pull_request, so a PR branch push starts two runs; it has no concurrency group, uses ubuntu-latest rather than the pinned ubuntu-24.04, and sets none of the GOPROXY=off/GOWORK=off/GOFLAGS guards the other jobs use. It tests ./internal/intake and ./cmd/corvint-intake without -race; both are in the root module and already run with -race in go-product. Whether the non-race run is an intended separate signal is not recorded.

completion.reason: V1-0718 delivered by beamfall/corvint#528, merge commit 472b7c679621135e8eb44bbdad9ec213637c3ced, with required checks green; full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN under the owner's standing scoped-work preference in AGENTS.md, manual disposition on focused tests, hosted required checks and independent review; evidence digests are sha256 of these files at that commit: 472b7c67:.github/workflows/intake-containment.yml 223dc396afae0423c8df89ce2f43767f9e8cdfc2389940b5f2b46f06d55903eb. AC1: .github/workflows/intake-containment.yml triggers once per PR head, has a concurrency group and uses the pinned runner and environment guards. AC2: the workflow states the job's distinct purpose instead of folding it into go-product. No build log; the evidence is the workflow file.

title: ci: intake-containment runs twice per PR push and repeats packages go-product already runs
